snippet.title: Overtrick | gameplay and launch trailer
snippet.description:
A trick-taking deckbuilder with style! Call your contract, follow suit, flush trumps, and claim the hand. Outplay your rivals, learn special abilities, and dazzle 1920s high society with your unstoppable cardplay. This isn't your grandma's bridge club... this is Overtrick!

Demo available on itch.io:
https://celloloops.itch.io/overtrick

Join our Discord:
https://discord.gg/3RmNr28eWj
